record.question: In the Kirby–Bauer disc diffusion method, the zone of inhibition around an antibiotic disc indicates:
options: Sensitivity of the organism to the antibiotic
record.explanation: Answer C: Sensitivity of the organism to the antibiotic. In standardized Kirby–Bauer disk diffusion, the inhibition-zone diameter is interpreted using organism/drug-specific breakpoints as susceptible, intermediate/increased-exposure, or resistant. A visible zone alone is not a universal susceptibility judgment; under the question’s conventional shorthand, it indicates organism susceptibility to the drug. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/68554/WHO_CDS_CSR_RMD_2003.6.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
